s01: Hello, my friend! (pause) Last week, we retold stories. (pause) Beginning, middle, and end! (pause) Today, we go to our classroom. (pause) We meet our study tools!
words: Look around a classroom. What do you see? (pause) We use four tools in class every day. (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap each picture and say the word!
words-1: Book. (pause) We read stories in a book.
words-2: Notebook. (pause) We write in our notebook.
words-3: Desk. (pause) We sit and work at our desk.
words-4: Pencil. (pause) We write with a pencil.
act: You know the four tools! Now let us use them. (pause) Let us play! (pause) I say it. (pause) You act it out!
act-1: Open your book! (pause) Open it wide.
act-2: Write in your notebook! (pause) Write, write, write.
act-3: Hold your pencil! (pause) Hold it gently.
act-4: Sit at your desk! (pause) Sit up tall.
find: Great acting! Now let us use our ears. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) I say a word. (pause) You tap the right picture.
find-q1: Where is the pencil? Tap it!
find-q2: Where is the notebook? Tap it!
vowels: Did you hear the short sound in desk? Let us learn more short sounds! (pause) Some letters have short sounds. (pause) A, e, i, o, u. (pause) They are vowels! (pause) Tap a line and say it with me.
vowel-tap: Now let us check your ears! (pause) Listen to the sound. (pause) Tap the picture that starts with it!
vowel-tap-q1: e, e. (pause) Which picture starts with e, e?
vowel-tap-q1-yes: Yes! e, e, egg! (pause) Desk has that sound too. (pause) d, e, sk!
vowel-tap-q2: o, o. (pause) Which picture starts with o, o?
vowel-tap-q2-yes: Yes! o, o, octopus! (pause) You hear the short sounds!
s1: You know the vowel sounds! Now let us read a story about a book. (pause) Story time! (pause) Our story is Tala's New Book. (pause) Teacher Ana gives out new books. (pause) Tala gets a red book. (pause) Thank you, Teacher Ana!
s2: Tala loves her new book. What does she do with it? (pause) Tala puts her new book on her desk. (pause) It is snack time! (pause) Bunso puts his cup of juice on the desk too.
mid: The book and the juice are close together. (pause) Quick question!
mid-q1: Where did Tala put her new book?
mid-q1-yes: Yes! The book is on the desk. (pause) Next to the juice. (pause) Uh oh!
s3: Then something happens! (pause) Oops! (pause) Bunso bumps the cup. (pause) The juice spills on the desk! (pause) It runs to the new book!
feel: Oh no! Let us stop and think. (pause) The juice runs to her new book. (pause) How does Tala feel?
feel-q1-yes: Yes! Tala is worried. (pause) What can she do?
s4: Tala thinks fast! (pause) Quick! (pause) Tala lifts her book up high. (pause) Bunso gets a cloth. (pause) He wipes the desk. (pause) I am sorry, Ate, he says.
s5: Is the book safe? (pause) The book is clean and dry! (pause) Teacher Ana smiles. (pause) Take care of your things, she says. (pause) Tala and Bunso cover their books.
order: That is the end of the story. Can you retell it? (pause) Let us retell the story. (pause) Tap the pictures in order. (pause) Beginning. (pause) Middle. (pause) End.
order-1: Beginning: Tala gets a new book.
order-3: End: the book is safe and covered.
order-yes: Beginning, middle, end! (pause) You retold the whole story!
my-care: Tala and Bunso take care of their books. What about you? (pause) Tala takes care of her book. (pause) What do you take care of? (pause) Tap one. (pause) Then say it with me.
my-care-1: I take care of my book.
my-care-2: I take care of my notebook.
my-care-3: I take care of my pencil.
my-care-4: I take care of my desk.
talk: Now show me YOUR school tool! (pause) Show me one of your school tools. (pause) Say: This is my pencil. (pause) I write with it. (pause) Your turn!
talk-example: This is my pencil. I write with it.
verse: Tala took care of her book. The Bible tells us why that matters. (pause) Our Bible verse is about small things. (pause) Take good care of them, like Tala did. (pause) Then God can trust you with big things!
verse-verse: Whoever can be trusted with very little (pause) can also be trusted with much. (pause) Luke sixteen, verse ten.
done: You worked so hard today! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You named four school tools. (pause) You said the short vowels. (pause) And you take care of your things! (pause) Tomorrow, we draw with paper, an eraser, and a ruler!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
